# pangolin_resource_policy_header_auth (Resource)

Sets header-based (HTTP basic) authentication on a Pangolin resource policy (Enterprise), for every resource attached to it. Destroying this resource removes the header authentication.

> **Note:** Credentials cannot be read back from the Pangolin API. After import, you must set `user` and `password` manually to avoid drift detection issues.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_resource_policy_header_auth" "example" {
  resource_policy_id     = pangolin_resource_policy.example.id
  user                   = "admin"
  password               = var.header_auth_password
  extended_compatibility = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password, 4 to 100 characters.
- `resource_policy_id` (Number) The ID of the resource policy to protect with header authentication.
- `user` (String) The username, 4 to 100 characters.

### Optional

- `extended_compatibility` (Boolean) Whether to enable extended compatibility mode. Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pangolin_resource_policy_header_auth.example <resource_policy_id>
```
